race.comment: ROYAL RENDEZVOUS (6) resumes. He showed good ability in his maiden campaign, winning well on debut at Werribee before tackling some handy races, well in the market against some nice ones. If he ready to go he'll take beating. INSAIN HARRY (5) resumes having been in great form last campaign. Second to King Tut before a break in town reads well for this and he maps for every hope, go close. KIPPIS (12) resumes having gone to the paddock a maiden winner at Cranbourne. She's got a strong starting price profile that says she'll measure up. NICEREINE (10) ran well first up at Sale, just finding one narrowly better. Fitter now and a strong hope. EXFORTYTHREE (7) next best.
